senses.gloss: m.(b. h. אֹפֶן; v. foreg.)turn, method, plan. [In later Hebr.: method of interpretation = פָּנִים.]—Pl. אוֹפָנִים; Du. אוֹפְנַיִים. Ruth. R. s. 2, beg. You will soon find out איפניים שלהם וכ׳ (Yalk. Josh. 7 אופנים) their plans (strategic movements). Ab. d’R. Nath. (ed. Taussig, N’veh Shal. p. 12) על אופניו in its proper way.
